# openstatus_playbook (Data Source)

Fetches a playbook the workspace has written, including its content. A built-in slug the workspace has never written is not found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openstatus_playbook" "status_page" {
  slug = "status-page"
}

output "status_page_playbook" {
  value = data.openstatus_playbook.status_page.content
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Slug of the playbook.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The playbook in markdown, as written. `{{name}}` marks a variable.
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `title` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `variables` (Map of String) Values set for the variables in the content, by name.
